shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在推车上固定好的气瓶旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a cylinder chained onto a two wheel cylinder trolley, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：气瓶的搬运、固定与储存。
overlay: 气瓶的搬运、固定与储存

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣拍拍固定链条
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot tugs gently on a tight chain holding a cylinder to the wall.
shots.narration: 搬得稳、拴得牢、放得对。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰斜着气瓶用手滚着走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tilts a cylinder and rolls it along the floor on its base edge.
shots.narration: 阿杰把新气瓶斜着滚进实验室。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 他把气瓶靠在门边，没拴
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans an unchained cylinder against the wall next to a doorway and walks off.
shots.narration: 随手往门边一靠，就去忙了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 王老师检查时皱眉指着它
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator frowns and points at the loose cylinder by the door during an inspection.
shots.narration: 王老师：这一靠，隐患一大堆。

shots.section_title: 气瓶一倒：断阀、扯管、砸人
shots.scene: 瓶颈处高亮，减压阀装在瓶颈上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder with its neck and valve highlighted, a regulator attached at the top. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶阀和减压阀都在瓶颈上。
overlay: 气瓶一倒：断阀、扯管、砸人

shots.section_title: 气瓶一倒：断阀、扯管、砸人
shots.scene: 气瓶倒下瓶颈折断，气体喷出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a falling cylinder hitting a bench edge, the neck snapping and gas jetting out. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶一倒，瓶颈可能折断。

shots.section_title: 气瓶一倒：断阀、扯管、砸人
shots.scene: 倒下的气瓶扯脱软管，砸到脚
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a falling cylinder pulling a hose off its connection and landing near a foot, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 还会扯脱管线，砸伤人。

shots.section_title: 气瓶一倒：断阀、扯管、砸人
shots.scene: 一排拴好的气瓶，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of cylinders standing upright and chained to a wall, with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 所以气瓶必须固定，不能倾倒。

shots.section_title: 气瓶直立放，乙炔瓶绝不卧放
shots.scene: 横放的气瓶滚动撞到瓶阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder lying on its side rolling and striking its valve against a wall, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 横放会滚动，容易碰坏瓶阀。
overlay: 气瓶直立放，乙炔瓶绝不卧放

shots.section_title: 气瓶直立放，乙炔瓶绝不卧放
shots.scene: 气瓶直立并固定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder standing upright, chained, with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶要直立放，并且固定。

shots.section_title: 气瓶直立放，乙炔瓶绝不卧放
shots.scene: 乙炔瓶卧放，溶剂流向瓶口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an acetylene cylinder lying down with liquid solvent flowing toward the valve, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 乙炔瓶卧放，溶剂会流出来。

shots.section_title: 气瓶直立放，乙炔瓶绝不卧放
shots.scene: 倒放过的乙炔瓶先直立静置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an acetylene cylinder standing upright next to a clock icon before use. No text.
shots.narration: 倒放过的，先直立静置再用。

shots.section_title: 专用链条或支架，到位立即固定
shots.scene: 【实拍】链条在瓶身中部和瓶肩之间两点拴紧（关阀）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands fastening two chains around a cylinder, one at mid height and one below the shoulder, then pulling them tight.
shots.narration: 用专用链条或固定带，拴紧。
overlay: 专用链条或支架，到位立即固定

shots.section_title: 专用链条或支架，到位立即固定
shots.scene: 拴得太低，气瓶从链条上翻倒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder chained near its base tipping over the chain, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 拴得太低，照样会翻倒。

shots.section_title: 专用链条或支架，到位立即固定
shots.scene: 绳子、扎带、弹力绳、铁丝打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rope, a cable tie, a bungee cord and a wire, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绳子、扎带、铁丝都不算。

shots.section_title: 专用链条或支架，到位立即固定
shots.scene: 墙装支架同时撑住满瓶和空瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wall mounted cylinder rack holding a full cylinder and an empty cylinder securely. No text.
shots.narration: 支架要撑得住满瓶，也撑得住空瓶。

shots.section_title: 专用链条或支架，到位立即固定
shots.scene: 气瓶到位，先固定，再接减压阀
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: step icons, a cylinder placed, a chain fastened, then a regulator attached. No text.
shots.narration: 到位立即固定，再接减压阀。

shots.section_title: 专用链条或支架，到位立即固定
shots.scene: 实验室里所有气瓶都拴好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab view with every cylinder chained, a single loose cylinder crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室里，不留一只没拴的气瓶。

shots.section_title: 瓶帽：不用和搬运时戴好拧紧
shots.scene: 可拆卸瓶帽和固定护罩两种
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a screw on cylinder cap and a fixed open collar guard around a valve, side by side. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶帽有可拆卸的，也有固定护罩。
overlay: 瓶帽：不用和搬运时戴好拧紧

shots.section_title: 瓶帽：不用和搬运时戴好拧紧
shots.scene: 不用时戴好瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chained cylinder not in use with its cap screwed on, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 不用的时候，戴好瓶帽。

shots.section_title: 瓶帽：不用和搬运时戴好拧紧
shots.scene: 【实拍】气瓶固定好之后才拧下瓶帽（关阀）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a cylinder already chained to the wall, then hands unscrewing its protective cap.
shots.narration: 先固定好气瓶，再拧下瓶帽。

shots.section_title: 瓶帽：不用和搬运时戴好拧紧
shots.scene: 用螺丝刀撬瓶帽打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a screwdriver prying at a stuck cylinder cap, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 瓶帽拧不动，不用工具硬撬。

shots.section_title: 搬运前：关阀、拆减压阀、戴瓶帽
shots.scene: 【实拍】关闭瓶阀、拆下减压阀、拧上瓶帽（不带压）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands closing a cylinder valve, removing the regulator and screwing on the cap.
shots.narration: 搬运前，关阀、拆减压阀和管路。
overlay: 搬运前：关阀、拆减压阀、戴瓶帽

shots.section_title: 搬运前：关阀、拆减压阀、戴瓶帽
shots.scene: 瓶帽拧紧，挪几步也戴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder cap being tightened before a short move, a short distance arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 哪怕只挪几步，也戴好瓶帽。

shots.section_title: 搬运前：关阀、拆减压阀、戴瓶帽
shots.scene: 搬运者穿戴防护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person wearing safety glasses, a lab coat, gloves and closed safety shoes next to a cylinder. No text.
shots.narration: 护目镜、手套、安全鞋穿戴好。

shots.section_title: 专用推车：不拖、不滚、不提瓶帽
shots.scene: 拖、滚、抱气瓶三种做法打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, dragging a cylinder, rolling it by hand and hugging it while walking, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不拖、不滚，也不抱着走。
overlay: 专用推车：不拖、不滚、不提瓶帽

shots.section_title: 专用推车：不拖、不滚、不提瓶帽
shots.scene: 抓瓶帽或瓶阀提起气瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand lifting a cylinder by its cap and another by its valve, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不能抓着瓶帽、瓶阀提起来。

shots.section_title: 专用推车：不拖、不滚、不提瓶帽
shots.scene: 【实拍】气瓶推上专用推车并锁好链条（关阀戴帽）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a capped cylinder tilted onto a cylinder trolley and secured with the trolley chain.
shots.narration: 用专用气瓶推车，拴好再推。

shots.section_title: 专用推车：不拖、不滚、不提瓶帽
shots.scene: 一次一瓶；两瓶用双瓶车
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single cylinder trolley with one cylinder and a double trolley with two cylinders both chained. No text.
shots.narration: 一次一瓶，两瓶用双瓶车固定。

shots.section_title: 专用推车：不拖、不滚、不提瓶帽
shots.scene: 标着空瓶，也小心推
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder with an empty tag being moved carefully on a trolley. No text.
shots.narration: 空瓶也按满瓶一样小心搬。

shots.section_title: 气瓶要倒，别去接
shots.scene: 气瓶从推车上倾倒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder tipping off a trolley, a person stepping back quickly. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶要倒了，别伸手去接。

shots.section_title: 气瓶要倒，别去接
shots.scene: 伸手接气瓶被砸伤打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person trying to catch a falling cylinder and hurting a hand, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 去接的人，反而更容易受伤。

shots.section_title: 气瓶要倒，别去接
shots.scene: 赶紧让开，事后报告检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person stepping aside, then reporting to the older man who checks the fallen cylinder. No text.
shots.narration: 赶紧让开，事后报告、检查瓶阀。

shots.section_title: 跨楼层人瓶不同梯，车辆运输按规定
shots.scene: 气瓶单独进货梯，人走楼梯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chained cylinder on a trolley alone inside a lift, a person taking the stairs. No text.
shots.narration: 跨楼层用电梯，人瓶不同乘。
overlay: 跨楼层人瓶不同梯，车辆运输按规定

shots.section_title: 跨楼层人瓶不同梯，车辆运输按规定
shots.scene: 电梯里漏气无处可逃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small closed lift with a leaking cylinder and a person inside, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电梯空间小，一漏气无处可逃。

shots.section_title: 跨楼层人瓶不同梯，车辆运输按规定
shots.scene: 电梯门口挂警示牌，楼上有人接
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a warning tag at the lift door and the female graduate student waiting at the upper floor. No text.
shots.narration: 挂牌提醒别人，楼上安排人接。

shots.section_title: 跨楼层人瓶不同梯，车辆运输按规定
shots.scene: 供气单位专用车辆直立运输
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas supply truck with cylinders standing upright and secured in a rack. No text.
shots.narration: 车辆运输，交有资质的专用车。

shots.section_title: 跨楼层人瓶不同梯，车辆运输按规定
shots.scene: 气瓶放进私家车、出租车打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder placed inside a private car passenger seat and a taxi trunk, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不用私家车、出租车运气瓶。

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉干燥通风，远离热源火源
shots.scene: 阴凉干燥通风、地面平整的存放处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cool dry ventilated cylinder storage area with a level floor and wall racks. No text.
shots.narration: 存放处阴凉、干燥、通风、地面平。
overlay: 储存：阴凉干燥通风，远离热源火源

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉干燥通风，远离热源火源
shots.scene: 阳光直射气瓶，温度计和压力表上升
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sunlight shining on a cylinder with a thermometer and a pressure gauge rising. No text.
shots.narration: 受热升压，不晒太阳。

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉干燥通风，远离热源火源
shots.scene: 远离暖气、烘箱、明火和动火点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder kept far from a radiator, an oven, an open flame and welding sparks. No text.
shots.narration: 远离热源、明火、可燃物和动火点。

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉干燥通风，远离热源火源
shots.scene: 激光加工时气瓶放在光路之外
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shielding gas cylinder placed away from a laser work area and out of the beam reflection path. No text.
shots.narration: 激光加工的气瓶，放在光路之外。

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉干燥通风，远离热源火源
shots.scene: 保护气积聚使人窒息，开排风
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: nitrogen and argon accumulating in a small room and an exhaust fan clearing it. No text.
shots.narration: 氮气氩气会积聚，保持通风。

shots.section_title: 储存：阴凉干燥通风，远离热源火源
shots.scene: 储存区禁止吸烟标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a no smoking sign at the entrance of a cylinder storage area. No text.
shots.narration: 储存区严禁吸烟。

shots.section_title: 可燃与助燃分开，不相容的不挨着
shots.scene: 可燃气瓶与氧气瓶隔开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flammable gas cylinder group and an oxygen cylinder group separated by a partition wall. No text.
shots.narration: 可燃气体和助燃气体，分开存放。
overlay: 可燃与助燃分开，不相容的不挨着

shots.section_title: 可燃与助燃分开，不相容的不挨着
shots.scene: 间距或隔断按标准和学校规定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two cylinder groups with a distance arrow and a rule book icon. No text.
shots.narration: 间距、隔断，按标准和本校规定。

shots.section_title: 可燃与助燃分开，不相容的不挨着
shots.scene: 会互相反应的气体分开放
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two cylinders that react with each other separated, a reaction icon crossed out between them. No text.
shots.narration: 会互相反应的气体，不挨着放。

shots.section_title: 可燃与助燃分开，不相容的不挨着
shots.scene: 储存处标明气体名称和危害
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a storage rack with blank name plates and hazard pictograms above each cylinder. No text.
shots.narration: 标明每种气体的名称和危害。

shots.section_title: 出口、通道、电梯旁不放气瓶
shots.scene: 出口和疏散通道放气瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder blocking an emergency exit door and a corridor, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 出口、疏散通道，绝不放气瓶。
overlay: 出口、通道、电梯旁不放气瓶

shots.section_title: 出口、通道、电梯旁不放气瓶
shots.scene: 电梯旁、人多处打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder by a lift door and in a crowded hallway, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电梯旁、人来人往处也不放。

shots.section_title: 出口、通道、电梯旁不放气瓶
shots.scene: 潮湿处、腐蚀品旁打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder on a wet floor and next to corrosive bottles, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 潮湿处、腐蚀品旁，不放气瓶。

shots.section_title: 满瓶、在用、空瓶分开挂牌
shots.scene: 【实拍】给气瓶挂上满瓶、在用、空瓶状态牌
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands hanging status tags on three chained cylinders.
shots.narration: 满瓶、在用、空瓶，挂牌标明。
overlay: 满瓶、在用、空瓶分开挂牌

shots.section_title: 满瓶、在用、空瓶分开挂牌
shots.scene: 空瓶区与满瓶区分开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an empty cylinder area and a full cylinder area separated with signs. No text.
shots.narration: 空瓶和满瓶，分开存放。

shots.section_title: 满瓶、在用、空瓶分开挂牌
shots.scene: 空瓶关阀、拆减压阀、戴瓶帽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an empty cylinder with its valve closed, regulator removed and cap on, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 用完关阀、卸表、戴瓶帽。

shots.section_title: 满瓶、在用、空瓶分开挂牌
shots.scene: 瓶里留一点余压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder cross section with a small amount of gas left and air kept out by an arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 不要用尽，留余压防倒灌。

shots.section_title: 易燃、有毒气体进通风气瓶柜
shots.scene: 【实拍】通风气瓶柜内的气瓶和排风口（关阀）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a ventilated gas cylinder cabinet with a cylinder chained inside and an exhaust duct on top.
shots.narration: 易燃、有毒气体，放进通风气瓶柜。
overlay: 易燃、有毒气体进通风气瓶柜

shots.section_title: 易燃、有毒气体进通风气瓶柜
shots.scene: 气瓶柜里漏出的气被抽走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: leaked gas inside a cylinder cabinet being drawn away through the exhaust duct. No text.
shots.narration: 防倾倒、防高温，漏气能排走。

shots.section_title: 易燃、有毒气体进通风气瓶柜
shots.scene: 气瓶柜旁的气体报警器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas detector on the wall next to a cylinder cabinet with an alarm light. No text.
shots.narration: 配好气体报警，周围严禁烟火。

shots.section_title: 易燃、有毒气体进通风气瓶柜
shots.scene: 楼外气瓶间集中供气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a separate gas cylinder room outside a building with pipes leading to the labs. No text.
shots.narration: 有条件的，设气瓶间集中供气。

shots.section_title: 按需存放，不囤积，及时退瓶
shots.scene: 实验室里只有两瓶在用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab with only two cylinders in use, a crowd of extra cylinders crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室只放必要数量的气瓶。
overlay: 按需存放，不囤积，及时退瓶

shots.section_title: 按需存放，不囤积，及时退瓶
shots.scene: 按本校规定的数量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rule book icon beside a cylinder count. No text.
shots.narration: 能放几瓶，按学校规定来。

shots.section_title: 按需存放，不囤积，及时退瓶
shots.scene: 不用的、超期的气瓶退回
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: idle and expired cylinders being loaded onto a supplier truck. No text.
shots.narration: 不用的、超期的，及时退回。

shots.section_title: 按需存放，不囤积，及时退瓶
shots.scene: 腐蚀性、易聚合气体看存放期限
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a corrosive gas cylinder and another cylinder with a calendar icon showing a limit. No text.
shots.narration: 腐蚀、易聚合的气体，盯紧期限。

shots.section_title: 按需存放，不囤积，及时退瓶
shots.scene: 查学校气瓶指南，不懂就问
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student reading a school gas cylinder guide and asking the safety administrator. No text.
shots.narration: 查学校气瓶指南，不懂就问。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 直立、链条、瓶帽图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, an upright cylinder, a tight chain and a cylinder cap. No text.
shots.narration: 直立固定，不用戴帽。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 推车、电梯人瓶分开、不接图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a cylinder trolley, a lift with a cylinder only and a hand not catching. No text.
shots.narration: 推车搬运，人瓶不同梯，倒了别接。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 通风、分开、状态牌、气瓶柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a ventilation fan, a partition wall, status tags and a cylinder cabinet. No text.
shots.narration: 阴凉通风，分类存放，少存快退。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣举着减压阀挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a gas pressure regulator and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：减压阀、管路与阀门。
